caption: The drawing depicts a wooden box with a slanted lid, rendered primarily in shades of reddish-brown and accented with fine light-colored lines that suggest inlay work along the edges. The lid features a circular medallion in the center, bordered by a lighter tan ring, with an illustration inside showing a dark bell or horn surrounded by a branch with leaves. Flanking the medallion on either side, there are two quarter-circle fan motifs in a pale tan color. The box has brass-colored metal handles on the sides and three front-facing drawers, all with small round brass knobs. Two of the drawers are pulled out to different extents, displaying their interior. A faint pencil box surrounds the main object, and in the upper left corner, there is a smaller, technical sketch of the box, displaying side and top measurements along with perspective lines. The entire composition is on a plain, light beige background.
title: Portable Secretary
